events.body:
## Context

`lib/src/util/validators.dart` has no tests, its messages say "emal", "atleast" and "Leter", and the password message lists `($, @, #, %)` while the regex also allows `!*?&`.

## What to do

1. Add `test/unit_tests/validators_test.dart` for valid and invalid email and password inputs.
2. Fix the typos and make the special-character list match the regex.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Tests cover both validators
- [ ] Typos fixed
- [ ] Message matches regex

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-flutter && flutter test test/unit_tests/validators_test.dart
```
